When that daily budget runs out, the provider answers with a “rate limited” (429) response instead of generating a reply. The countdown waits for the provider's suggested window, then your question is re-sent automatically — or you can retry now manually.

pricingPage.faqA1: Yes, you can change your plan at any time. When upgrading, you'll be billed the prorated difference. When downgrading, the new rate applies at the start of your next billing cycle.
pricingPage.faqQ2: Is there a free trial available?
pricingPage.faqA2: Yes! All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. You can explore all features of your chosen plan during the trial period.
pricingPage.faqQ3: What payment methods do you accept?
pricingPage.faqA3: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.
pricingPage.faqA4: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period.

legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the Freebuff dashboard platform. By creating an account or using any part of the service, you agree to be bound by these terms.
legal.termsS1Body: By accessing or using the Service, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms. If you are using the Service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization.
legal.termsS2Body: You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activity that occurs under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
legal.termsS3Body: You agree not to misuse the Service, including attempting to access it without authorization, interfering with its operation, scraping data in violation of our policies, or using it to transmit malware or unlawful content.
legal.termsS4Body: Paid plans are billed in advance on a recurring basis. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law. You may cancel your subscription at any time; access continues until the end of the current billing period.
legal.termsS5Body: We may suspend or terminate your access for violations of these Terms or where required by law. You may delete your account at any time. Upon termination, your data is retained for a grace period and then deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
legal.termsS6Body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be announced on this page. Continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance. Questions? Contact us at legal@dashboard.com.
legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to everyone who uses the Freebuff dashboard platform.
legal.privacyS1Body: We collect account information (name, email, organization), usage data (pages visited, features used), device and browser information, and payment data processed by our payment providers. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacyS2Body: We use your information to operate and improve the Service, provide customer support, send service and billing notifications, personalize your experience, and meet legal and security obligations.
legal.privacyS3Body: We share data only with trusted service providers who help us operate (hosting, payments, email delivery, analytics), and where required by law. We never sell your data to third parties.
legal.privacyS4Body: We retain data only as long as needed for the purposes described here or as required by law. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is restricted to authorized personnel.
legal.privacyS5Body: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. You can exercise these from your account settings or by contacting privacy@dashboard.com.
legal.privacyS6Body: For privacy questions or requests, contact our privacy team at privacy@dashboard.com. We respond to all requests within 30 days.
legal.cookiesIntro: Cookies help the Service work, remember your preferences, and understand how the platform is used. You can control most cookies from your browser, and we respect your choices.
legal.cookiesS1Body: These cookies are required for the Service to function — session authentication, security tokens, and load balancing. They cannot be switched off and do not store personal information for marketing.
legal.cookiesS2Body: These help us understand how the platform is used so we can improve it. They collect aggregate information such as page visits and error rates. You can opt out via your browser or our consent banner.
legal.cookiesS3Body: These remember your choices — language, theme, and layout preferences — so you do not have to set them again on every visit.
legal.cookiesS4Body: These are set by our advertising partners to show relevant promotions. We keep them off by default and only enable them with your explicit consent.
legal.cookiesS5Body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings at any time. Blocking essential cookies may affect how the Service works. Visit your browser's help pages for instructions.
legal.accessIntro: We are committed to making the Freebuff dashboard usable by everyone, regardless of ability or assistive technology.
legal.accessS1Body: We design and build the platform with accessibility as a first-class requirement, and we review new features against accessibility guidelines before release.
legal.accessS2Body: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA, covering perceivable, operable, understandable, and robust experiences.
legal.accessS3Body: All core workflows are operable by keyboard alone, with visible focus indicators. We support screen readers, magnifiers, and voice control on current browser versions.
legal.accessS4Body: Some third-party widgets or older charts may have limited accessibility. We track these issues and prioritize fixes based on user impact.
legal.accessS5Body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please tell us at accessibility@dashboard.com — including the page and assistive technology you use — and we will respond promptly.
legal.termsS7Body: By utilizing our standalone QRIS technology and cross-border disbursement rails, you agree to comply with Bank Indonesia and ASPI standards. Domestic e-wallet (DANA, GoPay, OVO, ShopeePay, LinkAja) and bank transfers settle in IDR. Cross-border card disbursements (Visa/Mastercard OCT) and international e-wallets (Alipay) are processed using transparent real-time FX reference rates with explicit network clearing fees.
legal.privacyS7Body: Payment status telemetry streams (SSE), transaction ledgers, and disbursement account numbers (e.g. DANA, BCA, Mandiri) are encrypted at rest and in transit. User profile avatars and product images uploaded (up to 10MB, including SVG vector formats) are strictly isolated to your tenant workspace and never monetized or shared with unauthorized third parties.
